reason: The frozen decision rule is satisfied (all C1-C5 pass) but the audit reduces the justified claim ceiling below producer's SUPPORTS outcome. Three high-severity findings constrain the evidence: (1) V-THRESHOLD-TAUTOLOGY: behavioral scores are strictly bimodal 0.35/0.65 and threshold 0.25 lies below both modes, so TP=1.0 is tautologically guaranteed regardless of noise that preserves these discrete modes — noise robustness is not discriminatingly tested; (2) V-ERROR-FORMAT-INERT: error_format_variation noise never reaches the wire (body replaced after resp creation without rebuilding resp, /api/schema explicitly pass), so effective production-like coverage is 3/4 types; (3) V-MOCK-ONLY-CEILING: all measurements remain on localhost Flask mock identical to parent ceiling, no production substrate tested. The experiment advances the C-FRESHNESS evidence base by confirming orthogonality survives beyond simplistic noise patterns, but the threshold tautology and inert noise type limit the strength of this advance. The 5th independent mock orthogonality confirmation (r=0.016, CI upper 0.1055) strengthens the established baseline but does not extend to production. The next step requires material infrastructure change (production-like substrate), not another mock experiment.
